name: rms
description: Cloud Restaurant Management System — offline-first POS core (Phase 1)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,pos -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rms/api" "npm run dev -w @rms/pos"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rms/api && npm run build -w @rms/pos
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rms/shared && npm run test -w @rms/api
scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/setup-env.js && npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @rms/pos && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit
